Let me check what's available in the installed uikit.

events.content:
Icons available: House, Person(s), ShoppingBag, Gear, Grip, ChevronsCollapseHorizontal, LayoutSideContent etc. 

Now design the app:

**App.tsx** — main layout:
- Sidebar (permanent, collapsible to icons): nav items Главная, Пользователи, Заказы, Настройки. Collapse toggle button at bottom/top. State `collapsed`. Active section state.
- Content area: shows section; Заказы section is the main table (but sidebar always present). Maybe main content always shows orders table for "Заказы", other sections show placeholder. Actually the task: "В центре — большая таблица заказов" — the center is a big orders table. I could show it under "Заказы" nav and make Заказы the default active section. Other sections can show simple placeholder cards.

**OrdersTable** features:
- Row selection: checkbox column (header select-all), selected Set, row click toggles, selected count display in ActionsPanel or a header bar.
- Column drag-and-drop: HTML5 DnD on header cells — since gravity Table renders headers internally, I need custom header rendering. Options: use `name` as function returning React node — but DnD needs to attach to the `<th>`. Alternative: build the table markup manually with plain `<table>` and gravity styling classes, which gives full control. Simpler and more robust: implement my own table using gravity's CSS class `g-table`? Hmm, the Table class component renders thead/th internally; I can't attach draggable to th.

Option: render custom header via `name: () => <div draggable ...>` inside th. The draggable div inside the header cell works for DnD — drag the header content. That works fine with HTML5 DnD: onDragStart sets column id, onDragOver preventDefault, onDrop reorders. The draggable element is the inner div spanning the header cell; acceptable UX.

Actually, simpler to write a custom table from scratch with gravity-uikit primitives (Checkbox, Label, Text). Full control over group header rows (colspan), selection, drag handles. Styling with gravity CSS variables. I'll build a custom table component — it's clean and satisfies all three interactions naturally.

**Grouping by status**: toggle control (Switch or SegmentedRadioGroup or a button "Сгруппировать по статусу"). When on: rows grouped by status, each group has a header row (colspan) showing status label + count, collapsible groups maybe. Keep groups collapsible (Disclosure-like) — nice but optional; I'll add expand/collapse per group since it's cheap.

Mock data: ~25-30 orders with fields: id, client, date, status (новый/в работе/доставлен/отменён/оплачен...), amount, city, items count, payment method.

Structure files:
- src/App.tsx — layout + sidebar + section switching
- src/Sidebar.tsx
- src/OrdersTable.tsx (with DnD, selection, grouping)
- src/ordersData.ts — types + mock data + status config
- src/styles.css — custom styles

Use gravity components: Button, Checkbox, Icon, Label, Switch/SegmentedRadioGroup, Text, Tooltip.

Design: The sidebar collapsed — width 56px vs 220px, transition. Use CSS variables from gravity (var(--g-color-base-background) etc.).

Status labels with gravity Label themes: Новый — info, В работе — warning, Оплачен — success? Let me define statuses: `new` (Новый, info), `processing` (В обработке, warning), `shipped` (Отправлен, utility), `delivered` (Доставлен, success), `cancelled` (Отменён, danger).

Column DnD details:
- columns state: array of {id, title, render, width}.
- draggable th: `draggable onDragStart onDragOver onDrop onDragEnd`. Visual feedback: dragging opacity, drop-target highlight (dragover index state).
- Checkbox column not draggable.

Selection details:
- selected: Set<string>. Checkbox in header: indeterminate state support via gravity Checkbox (`indeterminate` prop? gravity Checkbox has `indeterminate` prop). Check: gravity-uikit Checkbox supports `indeterminate`? Let me check quickly. Yes, gravity Checkbox has `indeterminate` prop (it mirrors HTML input.indeterminate). Let me verify in types.

Group selection: clicking group header checkbox selects all rows in group? Could be nice — add checkbox in group header.

Also row click toggles selection.

Selected info bar: "Выбрано: N" + "Снять выделение" button.

Let me verify Checkbox indeterminate and Label themes.
